item.title: Vance to host lawmakers at White House to discuss anti-fraud legislation
item.description: Vice President JD Vance will meet with about 20 members of Congress at the White House to talk about legislative efforts to combat Medicare and Medicaid fraud.

item.title: Giuliani suggests Mamdani skip 9/11 ceremony if it adds to victims' pain
item.description: Former Mayor Rudy Giuliani said New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani should consider not attending the Sept. 11 memorial if his presence would upset victims' families.

item.title: Mamdani faces more criticism after reversing grocery store decision
Wisconsin socialist Hong defends past remarks about canceling Thanksgiving
item.description: State Rep. Francesca Hong, a leading Democratic candidate for governor, is facing renewed scrutiny over her previous comments suggesting Thanksgiving should be abolished.
